title: Pocket Gongs, Plugged In
premise: Nested gong-like cycles, split wind melodies, and unequal dance groups meet DI guitars and resonant leads; structural borrowings, not a claim to perform any one tradition authentically.
pitch_policy: Exact original-field pitches only; all octave/register changes choose another existing pitch. Fixed common-tone bridges are allowed; no note is retuned while held.
